title: Rulebook scan state
description: catalog/scan-state.json of an organization rulebook repository: the package version the diagnostic scan recorded last per package and channel. Created by the first scan, never shipped by the template. See docs/reference/scan-mechanics.md.

scanned.description: A scanned version, or null when the channel was never scanned.
